digest.component_or_area: review-bot ticket clone and autodeploy bootstrap
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on the EBS-backed external volume does not refresh during redeploy because the entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, causing divergent history to persist across redeployments.

The reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh script must fetch the remote tickets branch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets and use rebar._store.sync.reconverge to self-converge compatible clones while preserving local-only commits.

Pre-epoch local clones must adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when the pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of the readable prior remote tip, with all other diverged or ahead states preserving the local tip exactly.
The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS must include infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh so that ensure-script changes reach the review-bot box automatically without requiring manual bootstrap.

Convergence failures must remain best-effort, never abort an already-cast Gerrit vote, and emit operator-readable warnings; fetch failures without credentials must preserve the local tip and return success.

After merge, a one-time hand-deploy must update /var/lib/rebar/mirror and install the merged autodeploy.sh while preserving owner 502:502, enabling normal rsync/build/health workflow for future ensure-script changes.
